entry_points.text: Run prepares translation, loads, activates signals, clears flags and loads floating state under lock, blocks while uninitialized, syncs registers, reconciles exceptions, drains completion, checks runnable and loops, then restores, writes back unless protected, unlocks and unloads.

Pre creation checks timekeeping, bounds identifiers, calls vendor logic and sets monitoring. Creation initializes tracking state memory interrupts buffers checks emulation floating faults quirks vectors and paging plus vendor Xen reset and memory with reverse unwind. Post creation syncs time and enables polling.

exports.text: Supplies run control, multiprocessor and debug and translation and floating state operations, processor creation, Xen events, signal masks and page cache init to upper layers.

Validates guest type into private memory and prefault flags, masks quirks, orders tracking and translation setup with cleanup, delegates to vendor, then sets locks, clock, frequency, bus, platform and monitoring defaults.
Stops timer and device work, flushes timer and interrupt activity, runs translation then vendor teardown, and retains routing until processors are freed for safe iteration.
Counts noncoherent devices, invalidating all mappings on first assign and last release only with the ignore attributes quirk. Shared memory init needs no private memory; reclaim delegates to vendor.
Instruction address is valid only during guest sampling and reads zero when protected. A kick is required exactly while the target runs in guest mode.

Prepares Xen mutex, port allocator and shared info cache, empty if compiled out. Hypercall completion applies only at the recorded address. Event routing needs asserted level; poll timeout unblocks and kicks.

hazards.text: Bad masks, failed sync, illegal priority, disallowed states, init needs, debug collisions, protected access and bad identifiers fail without entry. Missing completion is host bug. Uninitialized reports interruption or retry and unhandleable emulation fails cleanly.
Protected guests refuse floating and debug operations and skip exit writeback. Translation always reports supervisor writable so callers must not treat it as a permission check.

Idle suspend can miss elapsed time while faster resume needs padding and unreliable counters use catchup. Reboot must pin in interrupt context and release only in task context. Silenced registers may hang and deasserted level must be rejected.

invariants.text: Before each guest entry or block, execution leaves the instruction edge so sibling requested flushes during emulation force later steps to restart with fresh mappings.
Emulated memory access walks fragments in eight byte steps, copying shared data on reads only, advancing with an alias guard, clearing need at the end and rearming while fragments remain.

Without selector bits delivery returns; otherwise host bits merge atomically into the guest view and clear before setting upcall pending, wide for long mode and narrow for compat, plus message interrupt when configured. Disabled helpers do nothing.
Custom signal sets install on activation while saving the prior mask through a subset preserving update, and restore on deactivation. Both paths act only when a custom set is active.
Masks outside the allowed set fail. Dirty state syncs from userspace consuming the events bit. Output always syncs base plus events when asked. Exit writeback needs valid bits and unprotected state.

The slice also uses external helpers for single read and write, bit setting, bitmap fill, cpumask allocation, guest work checks, page allocation and address, killable mutex wait and error logging, with the shared subset listed as stubs.

locks.text: Sleepable read lock spans run and multiprocessor query, dropping around transfer work and uninitialized blocking, with signal work recording a signal exit. Controls load and unload while post creation uses an interruptible mutex.
Validity is checked under interrupt saving read lock, dropping for outside refresh then reacquiring to revalidate, aborting without guest touch on failure and marking dirty before unlock.
Creation sets timestamp, interrupt map, clock, optional HyperV and Xen locks, publishing time under timestamp lock with interrupts saved while teardown uses synchronous cancellation.

state_machines.text: The loop starts unknown and repeats on progress, marking off edge, entering if runnable else blocking, ending on nonpositive, else clearing unblock, delivering Xen and timer work, exiting on device requested windows and handling transfer work unlocked.

States are runnable halted uninitialized reset hold init received and legacy sipi. Creation is runnable without kernel chip or for bootstrap else uninitialized. Run blocks there. Setter folds legacy with pending sipi and requests event. Getter folds halted with unhalt. Pre run rejects legacy and impossible init.

Completion is single shot, fetching and clearing the callback with nonpositive ending the call. Stray port or memory flags without callback warn. Port needs nonzero count then resumes emulation while memory rearms until drained.

On backward host counter movement the delta marks every machine, shifts each processor adjustment, refreshes last readings with a clock request, and clears offset bookkeeping once, skipped without reliable counters.

Secure memory moves in up to eight byte fragments, copying on reads and advancing, clearing pending when drained else rearming. Port output clears count and repeats with residual while input delivers buffered data and advances.

structs.text: A fresh guest host cache holds an initialized lock and mutex, a machine back pointer, fault and invalid and bad sentinels, and cleared active and valid flags.

Floating exchange mirrors the kernel area with a one hundred twenty eight byte image, paired controls and whole vectors, skipped when confidential. Translation derives validity from sentinel mismatch, write allowed and user cleared.
A range pairs address, length and device. A bus holds counts with deferred reclaim plus a flexible range array, covering memory, port, virtio notify, fast memory, config and count.

Fallback dirty tracking reports zero reserved entries, always uses bitmaps, and nulls reset lookup push alloc and free behavior. The ring descriptor holds producer and reset positions, capacity, soft limit, entry array and index.

Identifiers equal max processors, fragments two, one address space, slot invalid bit sixteen and guest only bit seventeen with busy top bit, bus devices one thousand, and interrupt sources userspace zero, resample one and timer two.

Page errors sit at bit fifty two with eleven and twelve bit masks, noslot as top bit then fault poison read only signal and needs io. Host address errors use page offset forms. Requests use low eight plus bits eight nine ten, generic zero to three, arch base eight with validated construction.

Emulation flags occupy bits zero through nine for decode trap skip retry forced trap VMware fault user exit shadow write and soft interrupt skip. Task switch codes are call zero return one jump two and gate three.
